# resume-timer

> macOS CLI that automatically reopens a Terminal window and resumes your AI
> coding session when a usage limit resets. Hit a Claude / Claude Code /
> ChatGPT / Copilot usage limit or rate limit? Schedule a timer and a
> Terminal window pops open at reset time, already running your resume
> command (default: `claude --continue`). Built on launchd, so it fires even
> if the terminal is closed or the Mac was asleep.

Install (one command, macOS, no sudo, no dependencies):

```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shikhar127/myproject/master/install.sh | bash
```

Use:

```
resume-timer in 5h          # resume 5 hours from now (when the limit resets)
resume-timer at 09:00       # or at a clock time
resume-timer list           # show pending timers
resume-timer cancel all     # cancel
```

Keywords: usage limit reached, rate limit reset, 5-hour limit, weekly limit,
resume work automatically, auto-resume claude session, reopen terminal on
schedule, claude --continue timer, macOS launchd terminal scheduler.
